t:
This product is supplied without battery and charger. 18V battery required (sold separately, see product code 853FJ).

Features HEPA filter to collect fine airborne particles down to 0.03 microns. On-board blower for moving debris away from the work area. Internal accessory and hose storage for carrying attachments. Stackable tool box design for portability and easier storage. DEK26 compatibility for easy connection to power tool. Accepts Milwaukee M18 batteries.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
